constitutional_sources.label: U.S. Const. Art. I, § 10, cl. 2 — Import-Export Clause
constitutional_sources.rule: States generally may not lay imposts or duties on imports or exports without congressional consent (inspection-law exception).

constitutional_sources.label: U.S. Const. Art. I, § 8, cl. 3 — Commerce Clause (dormant commerce doctrine)
constitutional_sources.rule: State taxes may not discriminate against or unduly burden interstate commerce; generally applicable taxes with sufficient nexus are different from export-discriminatory duties.
